limitations: Original files stay local; manifest hashes identity, not financial correctness.
New result admission, bounded text guard and scripted SDK repair are not general semantic/arithmetic certification.
Authored corrected script consumes frozen input and changes under perturbation; arbitrary model scripts are not certified.
New mutation suite has behavior AssertionError evidence; old default also has mutation-induced runtime failures and is only a compatibility rerun.
Earlier dirty receipts and overlapping target suites are not summed with the clean full suite.
Old live runs remain failed and keep their original revision/model labels; no new retrieval or model session in this round.
No main merge, production switch, R5 integration, source restoration, or broader stable-update coverage is claimed.
